usage: 16_detect_front_from_concentration.py [-h] [--case CASE]
                                             [--file-prefix FILE_PREFIX]
                                             [--start-index START_INDEX]
                                             [--end-index END_INDEX]
                                             [--threshold THRESHOLD]
                                             [--min-component-pixels MIN_COMPONENT_PIXELS]
                                             [--bottom-rows BOTTOM_ROWS]
                                             [--max-front-jump MAX_FRONT_JUMP]
                                             [--connectivity {4,8}] [--nx NX]
                                             [--nz NZ]
                                             [--slice-mode {nearest_plane,slab}]
                                             [--slab-ratio SLAB_RATIO]
                                             [--y-round-decimals Y_ROUND_DECIMALS]
                                             [--interpolation-engine {spectral_element,scattered_linear,scattered_nearest}]
                                             [--slice-y SLICE_Y]
                                             [--interpolation-method {linear,nearest}]
                                             [--per-frame-griddata]
                                             [--workers WORKERS]
                                             [--reference-file REFERENCE_FILE]
                                             [--no-reference-comparison]
                                             [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                             [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR]
                                             [--rebuild-cache | --no-cache]
                                             [--overwrite] [--no-plots]
                                             [--diagnostic-indices DIAGNOSTIC_INDICES]

Detect a gravity-current front from concentration, then compare it post hoc
with an external front_simple.dat curve.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --case CASE           Configured case label. (default: N7)
  --file-prefix FILE_PREFIX
                        Exact Nek filename prefix before .fNNNNN. (default:
                        GC0)
  --start-index START_INDEX
                        Inclusive first Nek file index; omit for no lower
                        bound. (default: None)
  --end-index END_INDEX
                        Inclusive last Nek file index; omit for no upper
                        bound. (default: None)
  --threshold THRESHOLD
                        Fixed absolute concentration threshold. (default:
                        0.01)
  --min-component-pixels MIN_COMPONENT_PIXELS
                        Minimum bottom-connected component size. (default: 50)
  --bottom-rows BOTTOM_ROWS
                        Number of lowest grid z levels treated as bottom
                        contact. (default: 3)
  --max-front-jump MAX_FRONT_JUMP
                        Maximum x-distance from the predicted front, not a
                        velocity. (default: 0.5)
  --connectivity {4,8}  Connected-component neighborhood. (default: 8)
  --nx NX               Fixed-grid x point count. (default: 500)
  --nz NZ               Fixed-grid z point count. (default: 200)
  --slice-mode {nearest_plane,slab}
                        Midspan y-slice selection mode. (default:
                        nearest_plane)
  --slab-ratio SLAB_RATIO
                        Relative slab half-width for slab slicing. (default:
                        0.01)
  --y-round-decimals Y_ROUND_DECIMALS
                        Y-coordinate rounding precision for nearest-plane
                        slicing. (default: 10)
  --interpolation-engine {spectral_element,scattered_linear,scattered_nearest}
                        Concentration preprocessing engine. Spectral
                        interpolation evaluates the exact physical slice;
                        scattered engines retain the regression baseline.
                        (default: spectral_element)
  --slice-y SLICE_Y     Exact physical y coordinate for spectral
                        interpolation. When omitted, the first field file's
                        physical y-domain midpoint is used. (default: None)
  --interpolation-method {linear,nearest}
                        Legacy scattered-method selector. When supplied, it
                        must agree with --interpolation-engine and is invalid
                        for spectral interpolation. (default: None)
  --per-frame-griddata  Rebuild griddata interpolation geometry for every
                        frame, mainly for regression comparison and
                        benchmarking. (default: False)
  --workers WORKERS     Processes used only when building a concentration
                        sequence; cache hits do not start a process pool.
                        (default: 1)
  --reference-file REFERENCE_FILE
                        Optional front_simple.dat curve used only for post-hoc
                        comparison; it does not affect automatic detection.
                        Dynamic default: CASE_DIR/front_simple.dat.
  --no-reference-comparison
                        Disable only the optional front_simple comparison.
                        Automatic front detection, CSV output, and requested
                        diagnostics still run. (default: False)
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output directory. Dynamic default: /data/Nek5000_data/
                        results/poly_order_compare/front_detection/CASE.
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Directory containing the fixed-grid concentration-
                        sequence cache. Dynamic default is derived from the
                        case, selected frame range, grid and preprocessing
                        settings.
  --rebuild-cache       Force reconstruction and replacement of the
                        concentration-sequence cache. (default: False)
  --no-cache            Bypass cache loading and writing and rebuild the
                        concentration sequence in memory. (default: False)
  --overwrite           Allow replacement of all requested outputs. (default:
                        False)
  --no-plots            Write CSV outputs without reference-comparison
                        figures. (default: False)
  --diagnostic-indices DIAGNOSTIC_INDICES
                        Comma-separated Nek file indices for concentration-
                        field diagnostic figures. (default: None)

usage: 19_compute_leading_edge_evolution.py [-h] [--case CASE]
                                            [--file-prefix FILE_PREFIX]
                                            [--start-index START_INDEX]
                                            [--end-index END_INDEX]
                                            [--file-index FILE_INDEX]
                                            [--nx NX] [--z-target Z_TARGET]
                                            [--threshold THRESHOLD]
                                            [--y-upsample-factor Y_UPSAMPLE_FACTOR]
                                            [--ny NY]
                                            [--extraction-method {rightmost-crossing,moore-boundary}]
                                            [--x-min X_MIN]
                                            [--workers WORKERS]
                                            [--contour-time-spacing CONTOUR_TIME_SPACING]
                                            [--all-frames]
                                            [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                            [--overwrite]
                                            [--sampling-mode {uniform-spectral,refined-gll}]
                                            [--target-node-count TARGET_NODE_COUNT]

Interpolate horizontal Nek5000 concentration planes, extract the spanwise
leading edge, and write reusable CSV artifacts.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --case CASE           Configured Nek5000 case label. (default: N7)
  --file-prefix FILE_PREFIX
                        Exact Nek filename prefix before .fNNNNN. (default:
                        GC0)
  --start-index START_INDEX
                        Inclusive first Nek file index; omit for no lower
                        bound. (default: None)
  --end-index END_INDEX
                        Inclusive last Nek file index; omit for no upper
                        bound. (default: None)
  --file-index FILE_INDEX
                        Process exactly this file index; repeat as needed.
                        Incompatible with index bounds. (default: None)
  --nx NX               Uniform post-processing target-grid point count in
                        physical x.
  --z-target Z_TARGET   Fixed physical z coordinate of the horizontal plane.
                        (default: 0.04)
  --threshold THRESHOLD
                        Concentration contour defining the leading edge.
                        (default: 0.1)
  --y-upsample-factor Y_UPSAMPLE_FACTOR
                        Multiplier from native_ny to the uniform periodic
                        target count.
  --ny NY               Explicit endpoint-excluded periodic physical-y point
                        count; overrides --y-upsample-factor. (default: None)
  --extraction-method {rightmost-crossing,moore-boundary}
